title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.31309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling embedding capacity alongside Transformer computation is an emerging trend in language models. This trend makes high compression rates increasingly useful. Hence, we study extreme compression of Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE), which follow this trend and account for 35.2% of the parameters of Gemma 4 E4B. At such rates, conventional quantizers give each token-layer vector its own code of only a few bytes. We instead develop OPTIC (Output-Path-fitted, Token-shared Indexed Codes), which stores one quantized code tuple per token and decodes it at every layer with a layer-specific affine decoder. Codes and decoders are fitted to the PLE output path rather than to the stored vectors. At about $100\times$ PLE compression of bfloat16 (BF16) E4B, OPTIC retains an aggregate 97.8% of the uncompressed model's performance across seven benchmarks, whereas product quantization, the strongest of six conventional baselines, retains 66.3%. translated_title: 通过跨层潜在向量量化实现逐层嵌入的极致压缩
translated_abstract: 将嵌入容量与Transformer计算同步扩展是语言模型中的一个新兴趋势，这一趋势使得高压缩率变得越来越有用。因此，我们研究了逐层嵌入的极致压缩，这类嵌入顺应了这一趋势，占Gemma 4 E4B模型参数的35.2%。在这样的压缩率下，传统量化器会为每个token-层向量分配仅几个字节的独立编码。我们转而开发了OPTIC（适配输出路径的token共享索引编码，Output-Path-fitted, Token-shared Indexed Codes），它为每个token仅存储一个量化编码元组，并在每一层使用该层特定的仿射解码器进行解码。编码与解码器的拟合对象是PLE的输出路径而非所存储的向量本身。在对bfloat16（BF16）的E4B模型进行约100倍PLE压缩时，OPTIC在七个基准测试中总计保留了未压缩模型97.8%的性能，而六个传统基线中最强的乘积量化仅保留了66.3%。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出OPTIC方法，通过为每个token仅存储一个共享量化编码元组并用层特定仿射解码器在每层解码，实现对逐层嵌入约100倍的极致压缩，同时保留未压缩模型97.8%的性能，远超传统量化方法。
en_tdlr: OPTIC achieves extreme ~100× compression of per-layer embeddings by storing one token-shared quantized code tuple decoded at each layer with a layer-specific affine decoder, retaining 97.8% of uncompressed model performance versus 66.3% for the strongest conventional baseline.
